name: vaadin
description: Build Vaadin applications with current Vaadin documentation and Java API lookups, Vaadin Directory add-on search, and skills for project setup, Aura theming, visual design, and form layouts. Checks theme usage automatically after styling edits.

interface.longDescription: The Vaadin plugin helps Codex build Vaadin applications in Java. It connects two hosted Vaadin MCP servers: the documentation server, for current Vaadin documentation, component APIs, Java symbols, and the APIs added in each release, and the Vaadin Directory server, for finding and evaluating third-party add-ons. Skills cover bootstrapping a new project from start.vaadin.com, Aura theming, visual design, form and entity-editor layouts, and choosing and installing add-ons. A bundled native tool checks a project for Aura and Lumo theme mixing and for Aura custom properties the browser would silently ignore, and runs automatically after edits that touch styling.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Vaadin project in ./my-app.
Check the current Vaadin docs and add lazy loading to this Grid.
Find a Vaadin Directory add-on for picking a date range.
